about: Ford enhanced (mode 22) sensors, gathered from community lists (FORScan / Torque users). Ford doesn't publish these, so none is guaranteed: addresses and formulas can differ by model, year, engine and transmission. Use "Check factory sensors on this car" in the menu to see which ones answer. Headers: 7E0 = engine (PCM), 7E1 = transmission (TCM), 726 = body (BCM).

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp
sensors.note: Most widely shared Ford PID (6R80, 6F35, 6F50/55, 10R80). Fairly reliable.

sensors.name: Transmission fluid temp (PCM)
sensors.note: For Fords whose engine computer also runs the automatic gearbox, e.g. 2005-2010 Mustang with the 5R55S. Same request as above, sent to the engine module. Unconfirmed. Manual gearboxes have no fluid temp sensor.

sensors.name: Current gear
sensors.note: Commonly listed for the 6R80; the value encoding can differ between transmissions.

sensors.name: Oil life remaining
sensors.note: Guess: reported on many 2011+ Ford trucks.

sensors.name: Engine oil temp (PCM)
sensors.note: Guess: shared by F-150 owners. Try the standard "Engine oil temp" first; many 2011+ Fords report it.

sensors.name: Octane adjust ratio (EcoBoost)
sensors.note: Guess, from EcoBoost tuning forums. -1 = fully adapted to good fuel, toward +1 = pulling timing for bad fuel or knock. No reply on a 5.0.

sensors.name: 12V battery charge
sensors.note: Guess: from the body module on vehicles with battery monitoring (e.g. F-150).

sensors.name: Tire pressure, left front
sensors.note: Widely shared Torque PID for 2011+ F-150/Expedition (body module). Reads 0 or no reply until the sensors have transmitted (drive a little).
